name: Backblaze Personal Backup
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Backblaze Personal Backup, continuously back up a selected computer to user-owned object storage and test restores. The hard boundary is unlimited backup economics, client reliability, restore logistics, support, and durable infrastructure, plus reliability, durability, and cross-device sync.
